pre_measurement_clarification: Use the arithmetic mean for expected cumulative waiting time, because rare slow observations also consume time. Report frequency-weighted cell medians separately as a robust companion; neither average percentage speedups nor a geometric mean substitutes for total waiting. No candidate timing has been observed when this clarification is committed.
weight_evidence: Declared usage scenarios, NOT user telemetry; within-group cases equal; show all four profiles and cell deltas.
bootstrap_unit: paired cache history within case/mode; preserve its request sequence and both arms
confidence_scope: Empirical small-sample interval, not an industrial-population guarantee
missing_cells: Fail the aggregate; never silently renormalize
merge: Requires correctness, weighted benefit, runtime-quality and non-author source review; this experiment alone does not auto-merge
